title: Season 1
summary: The first season of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers began airing in the UK and US on January 3rd, 2009, on Jetix and The CW's CW4Kids networks respectively. It premiered in Italy on January 12th, 2009 on the Rai Due network. It follows the adventures of Lok Lambert as he is thrown into the world of Seekers and Titans motivated by the search for his missing father through clues left in his journal, unearthing ancient secrets along the way and battling the evil Organization.

sections.heading: Production
sections.wikitext: ''Huntik: Secrets & Seekers'' was created by [[Iginio Straffi]] as the spiritual successor to his successful show, ''Winx Club''. The first season was co-produced by Rai Fiction and Big Bocca Productions and animated by Rainbow SpA. A season of 26 episodes was initially announced [http://kidscreen.com/2006/10/01/cool-20061001/ here] in 2006 for a broadcast date of early 2008, but it was delayed by a year. It eventually premiered on The CW's CW4Kids block in the United States and on Jetix in the UK, both beginning on 3 January 2009. Following weeks of previews, it premiered in Italy on Rai Due on 12 January 2009. The first season ended in the UK on 29 January, in Italy on 16 January, and in the US on 5 September.
sections.text: Huntik: Secrets & Seekers was created by Iginio Straffi as the spiritual successor to his successful show, Winx Club. The first season was co-produced by Rai Fiction and Big Bocca Productions and animated by Rainbow SpA. A season of 26 episodes was initially announced here in 2006 for a broadcast date of early 2008, but it was delayed by a year. It eventually premiered on The CW's CW4Kids block in the United States and on Jetix in the UK, both beginning on 3 January 2009. Following weeks of previews, it premiered in Italy on Rai Due on 12 January 2009. The first season ended in the UK on 29 January, in Italy on 16 January, and in the US on 5 September.

sections.heading: Plot
sections.wikitext:
Lok's father, [[Eathon Lambert]], has been missing for ten years, and the only thing Lok has to remember him by is an ancient jar. When that jar is accidentally broken, Lok discovers a journal that discusses the mysterious Titans. The jar also contained an Amulet, although Lok doesn't know what it is at the time. Now Lok is teaming up with The Huntik Foundation to find and bond with Titans before the Professor, [[DeFoe]], [[Grier]], and the rest of the evil [[The Organization|Organization]] use them to take over the world.

Using [[Eathon Lambert's journal]], the team follows a series of clues in an attempt to find Lok's father. However, the search reveals a mysterious connection between Eathon and the Professor as well as clues to uncover the fabled [[Amulet of Will]], which is necessary for awakening [[Lord Casterwill]]'s [[Legendary Titans]].

sections.wikitext:
*In the first concept drafts for the series, there were a number of differences:
**Lok was originally called "Jason" and possessed the Amulet of [[Unnamed Titan 001]]. 
**Sophie was originally called "Sofia". 
**Dante was originally called "Brian Vale" and dark grey hair, a black jacket and an reddish-brown jumper. His original jumper can still be seen in a number of the official series posters. 
**Zhalia was called "Vanessa Lane" and had red hair. 
**The Titans were known as "Essences" and their icons did not appear when they were summoned.

A season of 26 episodes was initially announced here in 2006 for a broadcast date of early 2008, but it was delayed by a year. It eventually premiered on The CW's CW4Kids block in the United States and on Jetix in the UK, both beginning on 3 January 2009. Following weeks of previews, it premiered in Italy on Rai Due on 12 January 2009. The first season ended in the UK on 29 January, in Italy on 16 January, and in the US on 5 September.

Plot

Lok's father, Eathon Lambert, has been missing for ten years, and the only thing Lok has to remember him by is an ancient jar. When that jar is accidentally broken, Lok discovers a journal that discusses the mysterious Titans. The jar also contained an Amulet, although Lok doesn't know what it is at the time. Now Lok is teaming up with The Huntik Foundation to find and bond with Titans before the Professor, DeFoe, Grier, and the rest of the evil Organization use them to take over the world.

Using Eathon Lambert's journal, the team follows a series of clues in an attempt to find Lok's father. However, the search reveals a mysterious connection between Eathon and the Professor as well as clues to uncover the fabled Amulet of Will, which is necessary for awakening Lord Casterwill's Legendary Titans.

Home Media

See full list of DVDs
The first season was released on DVD in several countries, including the US, Italy, Germany and Australia. It was also released on Netflix, HappyKids.tv and many other streaming platforms. In October 2023, Rainbow created the official Huntik YouTube channel and began uploading all of the episodes of Season 1 onto the channel.

Trivia

• In the first concept drafts for the series, there were a number of differences:
• • Lok was originally called "Jason" and possessed the Amulet of Unnamed Titan 001.
• • Sophie was originally called "Sofia".
• • Dante was originally called "Brian Vale" and dark grey hair, a black jacket and an reddish-brown jumper. His original jumper can still be seen in a number of the official series posters.
• • Zhalia was called "Vanessa Lane" and had red hair.
• • The Titans were known as "Essences" and their icons did not appear when they were summoned.
